original_value: With superior performance and a leader in reliability, the WD Blue SSD offers digital storage that is optimized for multi-tasking and ready to keep up with your high performance computing needs. in both 2.5''/7mm cased and M.2 2280 form factors and WD's Functional Integrity Testing Lab (FIT Lab), the WD Blue SSD is compatible with a wide range of computers, so you can be sure you are making the right choice. Combined with the free, downloadable WD SSD Dashboard and a 3-year limited warranty, you can confidently upgrade your system to the WD Blue SSD.

result.paraphrase: Delivering strong performance and dependable reliability, the WD Blue SSD provides digital storage optimized for multitasking and built to handle high-performance computing demands. Offered in both 2.5''/7mm cased and M.2 2280 form factors, and backed by WD’s Functional Integrity Testing Lab (FIT Lab), it is compatible with a broad range of computers so you can feel confident you’re making the right choice. With the free downloadable WD SSD Dashboard and a 3-year limited warranty, you can upgrade your system to the WD Blue SSD with confidence.
